verdict.rationale: Pika's pricing materials say paid plans include commercial use ('For clients, brands, and paid work') and that the $10 Starter tier carries a commercial license, so the commercial-use half of the story is answered. Nothing in the evidence says who owns generated output, and no terms-of-service text is cited; the statements come from pricing and marketing pages. Missing for 10: an explicit ownership/IP assignment statement for generated output, actual terms-of-service language defining commercial rights (including Free-tier status), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, the vendor's terms state clearly whether I can use generated output commercially and who owns it
